screen: Research reader (Cash or Trash long-form article — SWDY)
summary: Full-bleed long-form reading view for a single piece of Barbarian research, opened from the Home feed's research list (nav state stays on Home). It is an article masthead + a dark "verdict" card carrying the Cash-or-Trash arc gauge, then alternating body prose, a dark pull-quote card, a light bar-chart card, and a closing paragraph with inline source links.

Nothing about this frame is unique to the reader, but the paddings determine every derived y-coordinate below.

components.name: Arc tick gauge — dial() builder
components.description: 56 radial tick marks across a 180-degree semicircle, filled left-to-right in proportion to value, with a big number + verdict caption stacked inside the arc and lo/hi end labels on the baseline. Shared with the Company screen (dialRange, size 214). FULL MECHANICS, exact as read: N=56; r=size/2; tick=round(size*0.145); ratio=clamp(0..1, (value-min)/(max-min)); filled=round(N*ratio); tick i is lit iff i<filled; angle_i = -90 + (i/(N-1))*180 degrees (CSS rotate, clockwise-positive, so i=0 points due WEST, i=55 due EAST, step = 180/55 = 3.2727deg; i=27 = -1.636deg and i=28 = +1.636deg, i.e. the zero/centre axis at 0deg lies exactly BETWEEN two ticks because N is even). For the verdict instance: size=230, r=115, tick=33, value=72, min=0, max=100 → ratio=0.72, filled=40 (ticks 0..39 lit, 40..55 dim).
components.styling: Outer box: position:relative; width:230px; height:(r+46)=161px. Each tick is a stalk div: position:absolute; left:50%; bottom:22px; width:2px; height:115px; transform-origin:50% 100%; transform:translateX(-1px) rotate(angle) → pivot at (115,139) in box coords. Inside each stalk, top-aligned, the visible mark: width:2px; height:33px; border-radius:1px. Lit mark: background:#E8621C with animation:bTick 220ms ease-out both, animation-delay:(i*9)ms. Dim mark: background:rgba(245,241,236,0.16), no animation. @keyframes bTick{from{background:rgba(245,241,236,0.16)} to{background:#E8621C}}. Because the mark sits at the stalk's far end, the tick band spans radius 82px..115px from the pivot; the arc apex is at y=24 and the baseline at y=139. Centre readout: position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:46px; text-align:center; big number font:200 46px/1 Outfit,sans-serif (round(size*0.2)), letter-spacing:-0.03em (-1.38px), color:#F5F1EC, font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; caption margin-top:7px, font:400 9px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif, letter-spacing:0.16em, text-transform:uppercase, color:#8E8781. Readout block spans y=53..115. End labels: lo at position:absolute;left:2px;bottom:0 and hi at position:absolute;right:2px;bottom:0, both font:400 10px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#8E8781; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums.

interactions: Screen entrance: the whole article column plays `bRise` — 240ms ease-out, opacity 0→1 with translateY(4px)→0. No stagger between blocks; the column moves as one.

Gauge fill animation: each LIT tick plays `bTick` 220ms ease-out with fill-mode `both` and animation-delay = i*9ms, where i is the tick's absolute index from the west end. Ticks animate rgba(245,241,236,0.16) → #E8621C. For the 72/100 verdict instance the last lit tick is i=39 → delay 351ms → the sweep completes at ~571ms. The wipe therefore reads left-to-right at ~3.27deg per 9ms. Unlit ticks never animate.

Back button tap → p.back = this.go(i, s.prev || fallback). The screen pushes back to whatever route was previously on this phone; if there is no history it falls back by nav group (pit→pit, you→you, market→market, else home). For the reader the fallback is Home.
Save button tap → toggles `saved`; background and icon colour cross-fade over `transition:all 200ms ease-out`. No haptic, toast, count, or label is specified.
Inline links: href='#' in the canvas. Hover colour #c8500f comes from the global stylesheet (web-only; irrelevant on touch). No press/ripple treatment specified.

Vertical scroll only; scrollbars hidden (`scrollbar-width:none` plus a global ::-webkit-scrollbar reset to 0). No sticky header, no collapsing title, no reading-progress indicator, no scroll-linked effects anywhere on this screen.

Bottom nav taps (goHome/goMarket/goPit/goYou) leave the reader and switch tab; the active pill slides via `bPill` 320ms cubic-bezier(.32,1.2,.44,1) (keyframes animate opacity 0→1 only, so the springy curve is applied to a fade, not a translate — the translateX is a static per-tab value).
NOT present on this screen: no FAB (that is `isPit`), no reply composer bar (that is `isPost`), no share sheet, no text-size control, no audio player, no comment affordance, no pull-to-refresh.
flutterNotes:
STRUCTURE. `Scaffold(extendBody: true)` + `Stack`: (1) a `CustomScrollView`/`SingleChildScrollView` with `padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16,54,16,124)`, (2) the 118px bottom scrim as an `IgnorePointer` + `DecoratedBox` gradient, (3) the floating nav. The article itself is a `Column(crossAxisAlignment: stretch)` with 20px `SizedBox` separators (or `Column(spacing: 20)` on Flutter 3.27+). Entrance: one `AnimationController` (240ms, `Curves.easeOut`) driving a `FadeTransition` + `SlideTransition(Offset(0, 4/height))` around the whole column. THE GAUGE — build it as a `CustomPainter`, not 56 widgets. Canvas size 230x161 (width = size, height = size/2 + 46). Pivot = Offset(size/2, height-22) = (115,139). For i in 0..55: theta = (-90 + i*180/55) degrees, converted to canvas radians as `rad = (theta - 90) * pi/180` if you measure from +x axis (CSS 0deg = pointing up), or simpler: draw each tick with `canvas.save(); canvas.translate(pivot); canvas.rotate(theta*pi/180); drawRect(Rect.fromLTWH(-1, -r, 2, tickLen)); canvas.restore();` where r = 115 and tickLen = 33 — i.e. the mark occupies radius 82..115. Use `RRect` with 1px radius. Lit colour 0xFFE8621C, unlit 0x29F5F1EC (0.16 alpha). Animate by passing a 0..1 controller value into the painter and lighting tick i only when `t*totalMs >= i*9` with a per-tick 220ms ease-out lerp between the two colours. `RepaintBoundary` it. The number/caption stack is NOT part of the painter — `Positioned(left:0,right:0,bottom:46)` with a centred `Column`; lo/hi are `Positioned(left:2,bottom:0)` and `Positioned(right:2,bottom:0)`. Use `fontFeatures: [FontFeature.tabularFigures()]` on the big number and both end labels. RE-SCALING THE GAUGE TO A SIGNED SCORE. The canvas formula is `ratio = (v-min)/(max-min)` with fill anchored at the WEST end. If you naively set min=-S, max=+S, a score of 0 lights ticks 0..27 — half the arc — which reads as "half good" instead of "neutral". Do this instead: (a) keep N=56 and the angle formula unchanged; (b) note that because N is even there is NO centre tick — the zero axis (0deg, straight up) falls exactly between i=27 (-1.636deg) and i=28 (+1.636deg); draw a dedicated static zero marker there (a 1px hairline at 0deg, full 33px, colour 0x66F5F1EC) so the origin is legible without colour; (c) centre-anchored fill: `mag = (v.abs()/S).clamp(0,1); k = (28*mag).round();` for v>=0 light i in [28, 27+k], for v<0 light i in [28-k, 27]; v==0 lights nothing but the zero marker; (d) re-index the animation delay to `distanceFromCentre*9ms` so the bar grows outward from zero rather than sweeping from the west; (e) render the big number WITH an explicit sign ('+20', '-50', '-6') — the canvas' `big` is a pre-formatted string, so sign formatting is your job; (f) set lo/hi to the signed bounds or keep the words ('Trash' / 'Cash'). Colour: if you introduce #A3402F for negative and #3F6B52 for positive, the caption text MUST still state the verdict word (the canvas already does this — `caption:'Cash'` is the text channel), otherwise you break the colour-alone rule. Note also that at S=50 with 28 half-ticks the quantum is 1.79 points per tick, so a -6 score lights only 3 ticks — verify that reads as intended, and consider a minimum 1-tick fill for any non-zero score. CSS `font: /` uses a unitless line-height multiplier → Flutter `height:` takes the same number directly (16px/1.65 → fontSize 16, height 1.65). `letter-spacing` in em must be multiplied out for Flutter's logical-px letterSpacing: .16em@11px = 1.76, .16em@10px = 1.60, .16em@9px = 1.44, -0.03em@40px = -1.20, -0.03em@46px = -1.38, -0.01em@24px = -0.24. Outfit weights map w200/w300/w400/w500. `text-transform:uppercase` has no Flutter equivalent — uppercase the string in code (and skip it for Arabic, see RTL). The title's `

There is no global `box-sizing:border-box` in this document, so the chart's `height:120px` with `padding:18px` is CONTENT height — the bar row is 156px tall overall and all bar percentages resolve against 120px, not 156px. Build it as `SizedBox(height:120)` inside `Padding(all:18)`, with each bar a `Flexible(flex:1)` + `FractionallySizedBox(heightFactor: .78/.84/.92/.88/.96/1.0/.82, alignment: Alignment.bottomCenter)`. On a 390pt phone each bar is 40.857pt wide — let flex compute it, do not hardcode. `max-width` IN ch. `34ch` on the dek and `62ch` on body paragraphs are readability caps; `ch` = advance width of the digit zero in the element's own font, which I did not read a px value for.
